state.name: localStorage (Zustand persist middleware)

state.name: localStorage (Zustand persist middleware)
state.description: User theme preference (dark, light, or system)

state.name: TanStack Query in-memory cache
state.description: Cached API responses for categories, category sections, and products with automatic stale/refetch lifecycle

failure_modes.trigger: DummyJSON API becomes unreachable or returns errors
failure_modes.impact: Shopper sees error boundary or empty product listings. No product data available. Cart and checkout still function for previously-added items.

cascade.effect: Category list query enters error state
Product list queries enter error state
Home page category sections fail to load
SSR loader throws, page renders error boundary

detection: TanStack Query error state surfaces in UI
SSR loader exception triggers React Router ErrorBoundary
recovery: TanStack Query automatic retry (3 attempts by default)
Shopper can refresh page to retry

failure_modes.impact: Shopper sees loading skeletons for extended duration. Infinite scroll pagination appears broken.

cascade.effect: Client-side queries show loading state indefinitely

detection: Prolonged skeleton/loading UI visible to user
recovery: No timeout configured -- request hangs until network timeout
Shopper can navigate away and retry

failure_modes.trigger: Browser localStorage is full, disabled, or in private browsing mode
failure_modes.impact: Shopper loses cart contents and theme preference on page refresh. Core browsing still works.

cascade.effect: Zustand persist middleware fails silently, cart state is ephemeral
Theme preference resets to system default on each page load

recovery: Stores continue operating in-memory without persistence
Cart and theme work within a single session

failure_modes.trigger: Server-rendered HTML diverges from client hydration (e.g., theme class applied server-side without matching client state)
failure_modes.impact: Shopper sees a brief flash of wrong theme on page load. No data loss.

cascade.effect: React hydration warning in console, potential UI flash
Theme may flash between states on initial load

detection: React hydration mismatch warning in browser console
recovery: Client-side useEffect corrects theme class after hydration

data_flows.name: SSR Data Prefetch
data_flows.description: Server-side loaders prefetch category and product data, dehydrate into HTML for instant client hydration

steps.action: Executes server loader, prefetches categories via TanStack Query
Dehydrates query cache into HTML response

data_flows.name: Product Browsing with Infinite Scroll
data_flows.description: Client fetches paginated products and loads more as the user scrolls or clicks Load More
data_flows.trigger: Shopper scrolls to bottom of product list or clicks Load More

steps.action: Triggers fetchNextPage on intersection observer or button click
Executes infinite query with skip parameter
Fetches next page of products from dummyjson.com

data_flows.name: Add to Cart
data_flows.description: Shopper adds a product to the cart, which persists to localStorage and shows a toast confirmation
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks Add to Cart on a product card

steps.action: Calls onAddToCart callback with product data
Adds or increments item in Zustand store, recalculates total, persists to localStorage

data_flows.name: Checkout and Order Placement
data_flows.description: Shopper reviews cart, fills shipping/payment forms, submits order, cart clears, redirected to success
data_flows.trigger: Shopper clicks Checkout in cart drawer

steps.action: Reads cart items and renders order summary, shipping form, and payment form
clientAction simulates order placement (1s delay), clears cart, sets successfulOrder flag
Displays confirmation with confetti animation, resets successfulOrder flag

data_flows.name: Theme Toggle
data_flows.description: Shopper toggles dark/light mode, preference persists to localStorage and applies to document root

steps.action: Updates document.documentElement classList, persists to localStorage
